rules.title: City Council policy order on algorithmic rent-pricing software
rules.requirement: The council directed the city manager to work with city departments to draft policy options or ordinance language banning residential property management companies from contracting with firms that use algorithmic or AI-driven models to recommend rents. No ban is in force yet.
rules.citation: Cambridge City Council policy order (June 2026), no number given
rules.status_basis: Policy order passed unanimously directing staff to draft options or ordinance language to present to council later this term; no ordinance adopted yet.

coverage.summary: Would apply to residential property management companies that use algorithmic pricing services.

rules.quoted_span: City council also unanimously passed a policy order initiating steps to ban residential property management companies from contracting companies that use algorithmic and AI-driven models to recommend what they should charge for rent.
